summary: Build circular business cases, KPI dashboards, and implementation roadmaps. Train with TrainingCred on circular economy business models.
lede: Circular economy business model training focuses on turning circular opportunities into practical plans. For professionals in product, supply chain, operations, sustainability, and innovation, it covers opportunity screening and value cases, models for resource recovery, product life extension and product-as-a-service, plus traceability, implementation roadmaps, and KPI reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work near product, supply chain, operations, sustainability, or innovation decisions and now need a clearer circular economy business model toolkit. It fits people who are expected to shape business cases, coordinate across functions, and translate circular ideas into practical plans that leadership can review and fund. Sustainability Managers responsible for circular business case development. Product Managers redesigning offerings for durability, repair, or access. Supply Chain Managers managing reverse logistics and recycled inputs. Innovation Managers screening circular business opportunities and pilots. Operations Managers coordinating remanufacturing and take-back processes. Procurement Managers sourcing recyclable and renewable materials. Circular Economy Specialists shaping model selection and partner ecosystems. Commercial Managers pricing service-based or access-based offerings. Materials Managers tracking feedstocks and recovery pathways. ESG Reporting Leads linking circular KPIs to executive reporting.
modules: Opportunity screening and value case analysis
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and the ability to work through business case templates and mapping exercises. If you bring one product, service, or material flow from your organization, you can adapt the exercises directly to your context.
